name: ignis-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Ignis: a browser-based Obsidian client. Self-hosted server in apps/ignis-server; shim, UI, and shared libraries in packages/.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev:server
scripts.lint: oxlint packages apps/ignis-server/server scripts --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/check-error-leaks.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture.mjs
scripts.test:management: node scripts/check-management-ui.mjs && node scripts/check-management-ui.mjs --mobile && node scripts/check-management-ui.mjs --mobile --compact && node scripts/check-management-ui.mjs --mobile --landscape
scripts.test:terminal-ui: node scripts/check-terminal-ui.mjs && node scripts/check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --terminal-ui && node scripts/check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --terminal-ui --mobile
scripts.test:management-parity: node scripts/check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --management-parity && node scripts/check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --management-parity --wide && node scripts/check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --management-parity --mobile && node scripts/check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --management-parity --mobile --compact && node scripts/check-obsidian-runtime.mjs --management-parity --mobile --landscape
